We need your help to get the word out about what a public bank can do for SF before ballots drop! RSVP here Organizing Mindset Training: Basebuilding 101, How to Have an Effective Organizing Conversation Every Thursday at 7PM from Sep 17 through Oct 8 DSA SF Office – 1916 McAllister St Talking to people is central to effective organizing, but how do you embark on an organizing conversation? Organizing Mindset Training is a four-part event series that goes in depth into every aspect of the organizing conversation so that it’s a sharpened and ready-to-use tool for any campaign. After this training, participants will: Learn about the differences between organizing, advocacy, and direct services/mutual aid Understand of the role of an Organizing Committee and carrying out an organizing strategy Overview the Organizing Conversation and get in-depth practice for each step Develop the ability to have multiple successive organizing conversations with a person, with the goal of getting them more involved in your organizing Attendance of all four sessions isn’t required, but it is encouraged! RSVP HERE Organizing Mindset Training: Basebuilding 101, How to Have an Effective Organizing Conversation DSA SF movie nights are back with The Battle of Chile ! We will bring to life the heroic struggles of the working people of Chile and Salvador Allende’s presidency in the lead up to the US-backed fascist coup of Sept 11, 1973. These films will give us a glimpse into a powerful class-wide grassroots movement which won the country’s highest elected office and controlled vast sectors of industry and community networks on the ground. Join us on Fridays Sept 18 , Sept 25 , and Oct 2 in the DSA SF office at 1916 McAllister St . Snacks and soft drinks will be provided. Bring a friend! RSVP Here
